entries.9e13a138350e1a5c: It conducts the manufacture and sale of semiconductor test equipment as a single business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,567 million, accounting for all consolidated revenue. The company and four consolidated subsidiaries (TESEC,INC., TESEC(M)SDN.BHD., Taisai Kokusai Boeki (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and Ryōkō Onden Denki Co., Ltd.) make up the group; the company develops, manufactures and sells handlers, testers and parts, among others, and provides after-sales service; the overseas subsidiaries sell the company's products and provide after-sales service; and Ryōkō Onden Denki develops, manufactures and sells semiconductor measuring instruments and provides after-sales service. Its main locations are the head office (Higashiyamato, Tokyo) and the Ina Office (Minowa, Kamiina District, Nagano Prefecture).
